product_metadata.title: 7.2 Inch Kitchen Compost Bin Filters Charcoal Replacements, ENLOY 12 Pack Charcoal Filters for Countertop Home Bucket, Longer Lasting Round Extra Thick Activated Charcoal
features: Dimensions: For round compost bin filter, the diameter is 7.2 inches and the thickness is 8 mm, can fit for most of covers of compost pails well.

Adsorption effect: It will give off the unpleasant and food odor when you put rubbish into compost pails for a quite long time. Compost bin filters can filter and absorb odor to ensure clean and fresh air in the kitchen.
Material: Made of activated carbon. Eco-friendly and durable. Can filter a large proportion of terrible and odor effectively. In order to keep good filtering effect, washing is not recommended.
Easy to set up: Just to inlay the compost bin filter into the cover of compost pail, the compost bin filters will work. The compost bin filter also can be cut out to your required size.

Package includes: 12 pieces of round compost bin filters per pack, The suggestion is that we should change compost bin filters every 2-3 months. The quantity is enough for you to use for 1 year or longer.
